about: PART 1 OF THE JOB: the gate, pinned. Gates 177 and 178 (gates/drive/layout.js, TC-R248a..f) render sampled screen states at 7 phones (375x761, 390x844, 414x896, 430x932 with his insets; 320x568, 360x640, 375x667 without) each at 4 text sizes (50, 75, 100, 125 percent, as the viewport the page zoom gives), and read overlap, text cut, spill, sideways scroll, the board's side gaps and a card's side gaps; a finding that is not on gates/fixtures/177-layout-pins.json is red. Graded here on four of its states (Home, the Review list, Review at move 10, a puzzle with its hint) on a trial bundle: the real code passes with today's faults pinned, and three new faults - each of a different kind - are caught on both sets of phones. NOT COVERED YET: the fixes themselves (parts 2 and 3 of the job turn pinned lines into plain ones and add their own breaks here); the other 32 states (run by the gates, not by this pair); a fault of a pinned kind on a pinned element in a pinned cell; his phone's fonts.

breaks.name: the-vs-sits-on-the-name
breaks.why: on the game card the word vs is pulled 22px left, onto the end of the opponent's name: text on text

breaks.name: the-board-leaves-a-side-gap
breaks.why: the board is pushed 16px in from the left edge on every board screen, so it no longer fills the width where it does today

breaks.name: home-scrolls-sideways
breaks.why: Home's first card is made wider than the screen, so Home scrolls sideways and the card runs off the right edge
